- The Company converted from a partnership firm during FY 2024-25 and listed on the NSE Emerge SME platform; the annual report itself cautions that FY2024-25 figures combine the erstwhile partnership firm and the Company and that comparatives 'are not directly comparable with the corresponding figures reported in the consolidated financial statements'. This is the second AGM of the Company.
- As on 31 March 2026 the Board comprised five members of whom four are members of the Merchant promoter family and only one was an Independent Director, following the resignation of Mrs. Seema Shashank Mhatre on 27 February 2026; a second Independent Director was appointed only on 18 May 2026, after the year end. The Company is listed on NSE Emerge and is exempt from the corporate governance provisions of Regulation 15 of SEBI LODR, so no Corporate Governance Report is furnished. (Read from the Board's Report routed into the governance_entities bundle.)
- The annual report's disclaimer states that business plans, growth prospects and outlook 'are based on management's current expectations, estimates and assumptions and are subject to various risks and uncertainties' and that actual results may differ materially, and that industry trend and market-size data (including the USD 30 bn+ retail automation and USD 800 bn+ home interiors TAM figures) is from public sources or management estimates and 'has not necessarily been independently verified'.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Build out manufacturing capacity as the core growth lever - the Ambernath integrated facility (250,000 sq. ft., targeted December 2026) plus the completed Pune expansion, described by the Chairman as a major strategic milestone that will enhance throughput, efficiency and scalability.
- Move beyond conventional shopfitting into smart retail infrastructure via THE WAVE, an RFID- and IoT-based self-checkout / POS solution, entering the retail automation industry.
- Extend precision-engineering and modular-design capability from commercial retail into home and lifestyle interiors through EVOLV …
